title: Farm Peace IPO Details
intro:
Farm Peace IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹32.00 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 54.24 lakh shares of ₹32.00 crore.

Farm Peace IPO opens for subscription on Sep 1, 2026 and closes on Sep 3, 2026. The allotment for the Farm Peace IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 4, 2026. Farm Peace IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 8, 2026.

Farm Peace IPO is set final issue price at ₹59 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,36,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,54,000.

Socradamus Capital Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Shreni Shares Ltd.

Refer to Farm Peace IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in October 2021, Farm Peace is an integrated contract farming company focused on processed-grade potato varieties like Santana, Frysona, Innovators, Lady Rosetta, and Chipsona. These potatoes are supplied to processing companies for French fries, chips, and other value-added products.

Operating under the “Farm Peace” brand, the company work closely with farmers in Gujarat through a 100% buy-back model . It provide certified seeds, agronomic support, fertilizers, pesticides, and modern farming techniques like drip irrigation to help farmers improve yields and reduce risks. In return, it assure them of buying their produce at pre-agreed prices, protecting them from market fluctuations.

The company supports farmers at every stage—seed selection, soil preparation, irrigation, pest management, harvesting, and post-harvest handling. With cold storage and temperature-controlled logistics, it ensures quality produce reaches processors without losses.
As of August 2026, the company operates mainly in Gujarat, India, under the “ Farm Peace ” brand, cultivating over 5,660 acres and producing 61,680 metric tonnes of potatoes annually.

Incorporated in October 2021, Farm Peace is an integrated contract farming company focused on processed-grade potato varieties like Santana, Frysona, Innovators, Lady Rosetta, and Chipsona. These potatoes are supplied to processing companies for French fries, chips, and other value-added products.

Operating under the “Farm Peace” brand, the company work closely with farmers in Gujarat through a 100% buy-back model . It provide certified seeds, agronomic support, fertilizers, pesticides, and modern farming techniques like drip irrigation to help farmers improve yields and reduce risks. In return, it assure them of buying their produce at pre-agreed prices, protecting them from market fluctuations.

The company supports farmers at every stage—seed selection, soil preparation, irrigation, pest management, harvesting, and post-harvest handling. With cold storage and temperature-controlled logistics, it ensures quality produce reaches processors without losses.

As of August 2026, the company operates mainly in Gujarat, India, under the “ Farm Peace ” brand, cultivating over 5,660 acres and producing 61,680 metric tonnes of potatoes annually.

The minimum order quantity is 2000 . The IPO opens on Tue, Sep 1, 2026 , and closes on Thu, Sep 3, 2026 . Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar for the IPO . The shares are proposed to be listed on BSE SME .

faqs.question: How to apply in Farm Peace IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Farm Peace IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Farm Peace IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Farm Peace IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Farm Peace IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Farm Peace IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Farm Peace IPO opens on Tue, Sep 1, 2026 and closes on Thu, Sep 3, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Farm Peace IPO?
faqs.answer: Farm Peace IPO lot size is 2000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,36,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Farm Peace IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Farm Peace IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Farm Peace IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Farm Peace IPO will be done on Friday, September 4, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Sep 7, 2026 . Check the Farm Peace IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Farm Peace IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Farm Peace IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Sep 8, 2026 .
